Single cells are-not staying single where food is-not, and a society opens as one self going; its aiming is social moral competency of its cells' parities, a society's next, spores lifting, and far more than light is co-competencing the parities of each me cell, light, warmth, ammonia, a surface, each cell's place front or rear. Phototaxis, thermotaxis, an altruist stalk and a beneficiary spore are a field's one-cause and agent stories over that. *(possible exploring)*
